criticalFindings.title: Non-hex pseudo-digests used as content addresses
criticalFindings.description: The desk's review and product artifacts cite digests containing the letters g through z, which are not hex characters. The kernel's own ingress law (SHA256_HEX = /^[0-9a-f]{64}$/, src/workflow-kernel/workshops/formalization/ingress.ts:39) refuses such refs as BYTES_CORRUPT. The prior review therefore certified acceptance criteria using content addresses the kernel itself would refuse at its own boundary.
criticalFindings.impact: Complete content-address transport failure for the review layer. No downstream component can resolve these refs to bytes.

criticalFindings.title: One digest declared as the content address of 35 distinct files
criticalFindings.description: Digest a926df6284a1afb5e1d7e899b1279acd746d40d48658de6dd0d2a368f76b2837 is declared simultaneously as the architecture-contract digest (contract .md header line 4), the trace digest (trace.json traceRef AND contentDigest, lines 2-4), and the subjectContractDigest of the prior review - and is additionally cited by 30+ files of other desks in this qualification set (define-acceptance-contract, define-architecture-contract, define-product-intent, freeze-what-baseline, settle-formalization). A content address addresses exactly one artifact; one address for dozens of distinct artifacts collapses the entire content-address namespace.

evidence.fact: declared digest is identical across all three while all three actual digests differ

violatedPrinciples: capsule law: capsuleRef is DERIVED from canonical facts (ingress.ts:99-129)
criticalFindings.impact: Self-address verification at ingress would refuse every one of these artifacts (BYTES_CORRUPT). The declared addresses are provably not content-derived.

criticalFindings.title: Trace and evidence digests are unresolvable and belong to a different desk's claim set
criticalFindings.description: The desk trace and product evidence cite SC-1..TC-2 digests (fbe292e8..., c9bfe922..., 423be112..., d7ce453b..., f7acf9d1..., c292f694..., f3d0a6a4...). (a) None of the seven digests matches the sha256 of any file in the qualification tree - they resolve to no content. (b) They are the derive-system-requirements desk's WP-053 claim set, not the capsule projected to THIS desk. The task projection of the import-discovery-handoff desk carries source-claim digests b15c35da..., cb291aa7..., 6652762b..., 3d576e96..., constraint 807393968f..., unknown 38fc9cb1..., terminal claims 4a559317... and 8ce2f289... The trace claims 'contentAddressing: verified' while every endpoint of every trace edge is unresolvable or foreign.

requiredActions.description: Recompute every desk artifact's digest over its canonical bytes
requiredActions.details: sha256 over exact file content for the contract .md, contract .artifact.json, trace, product and review artifacts. One artifact = one address; the address goes in the artifact's own header only if it is computed over content that excludes the self-address field (two-pass sealing), otherwise reference the content address from the parent artifact only.
Replace 8f3a1c7b...m0n2o4p and 9e4d8f2a...y2z4 everywhere (review, review.artifact, product, product-submission, submission-summary) with computed SHA-256 values.

IF those can be resolved against actual capsule bytes; otherwise reference artifacts by claim ID (claim:scope-1 ...) and mark digests as pending capsule-byte resolution. Never keep unresolvable digests.

recommendation: REJECT the formalization artifact set for mechanical digest repair and resubmission. The architecture contract AC-Import-Discovery-Handoff-001 is substantively sound and accurately mirrors the real ingress (ingress.ts) and shell-desk wiring (driver.ts) - no semantic re-authoring is required. But the set fails its own CON-1 transport law three ways: non-hex pseudo-digests, one collision digest addressing 35 files, and evidence digests that are unresolvable and foreign to this desk's capsule projection. The prior ACCEPT verdict is void because its own content address cannot resolve. This repeats the exact CRIT-003 defect class recorded in define-product-intent-reviewer-decision-v2.json; the desk formalization pipeline that emits these digests is the common cause and should be fixed at that level.
